data.name: Grassroots Biochar
data.description: Grassroots Biochar AB is a small Swedish biochar producer based on Öland/Kalmar that makes and refines biochar products for agricultural, horticultural and soil-management uses. The company is a production company of biochar-based products located in Kalmar, Sweden, using the Kon-Tiki burning method, focused on the agricultural sector. Their products are reported to be EBC certified.
